## Professional biography

Guy Bavaro is a global business and technology executive who builds and leads commercial organizations, develops strategic partnerships and scales revenue across technology and media businesses. His experience spans Electronic Arts, X / xAI, Snap Inc., Microsoft and Yahoo, including team leadership, complex commercial agreements, technology partnerships and go-to-market execution. He leads Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts.

## Aggregate career outcomes

Guy states that he has generated more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career and helped scale businesses from zero to billions. This is an aggregate career statement, not company-specific revenue disclosure or a claim of sole individual sales credit.
Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#outcomes

## Revenue leadership examples

### Electronic Arts: Building Commercial Systems That Drive Revenue

At Electronic Arts, I lead the global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnership teams, with responsibility for building the relationships, capabilities, and commercial approach that help grow advertising revenue.

I connect the value of Electronic Arts’ participating audience with media planners, buyers, and brands at the right points in their planning and buying cycles.

Working with Sales and cross-functional teams, I focus on removing barriers to investment and making opportunities easier to understand, plan, and activate. My teams develop agency demand and technology partnerships, while Sales leads account closing. Together, we create a clearer path from audience value to advertiser investment.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/#ea-revenue

### X / xAI: Leading Holding-Company Revenue Growth

I was responsible for holding-company advertising revenue at X / xAI, leading the team and commercial strategy behind growth across global agency relationships.

My tenure began at X and continued after X became part of xAI.

My focus was turning those relationships into advertiser investment through commercial agreements, technology partnerships, and coordinated execution. That included developing a partnership with a global agency holding company that connected X’s real-time signals with agency planning and activation workflows.

Revenue growth was my accountability. Partnerships, team leadership, and execution were how I pursued it.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/#x-revenue

### Snap Inc.: Leading Teams That Generate Revenue

At Snap Inc., I directly managed the team responsible for generating advertising revenue through our agency partnerships.

The goal was to grow investment by making Snap Inc.’s capabilities easier for agencies and advertisers to adopt. I led the team’s commercial approach and worked across Snap Inc. and a global agency holding company to address barriers in education, creative production, approvals, and activation.

My responsibility connected people leadership with commercial performance: developing the team, setting priorities, and translating partner relationships into revenue-generating business.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/#snap-revenue

## Career experience

### Electronic Arts

Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships. Lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships, building the agency and technology relationships that support commercial growth across Electronic Arts’ gaming and interactive entertainment portfolio.

### X / xAI

Head of Global Agency Development & Sales Partnerships. Led global agency development and sales partnerships at X, bringing together commercial team leadership, holding-company strategy, commercial negotiations, and advertising technology business development.

### Snap Inc.

Global Agency Development. Led global agency partnerships, executive holding-company relationships, and commercial programs supporting investment and adoption across mobile, social, and augmented reality advertising.

### Microsoft

Advertising Sales & Agency Development Leadership. Led advertising sales and agency development organizations, developed leaders, and built commercial partnerships across search, video, and digital advertising.

### Yahoo

Global Agency Development. Led global agency development, trading strategy, and business development supporting search, content, and native advertising.

## Business leadership

### Business Growth

Build commercial strategies that translate emerging opportunities into customer adoption, investment, and sustained revenue.

### Organizational Leadership

Develop teams and leaders, establish clear priorities, and create accountability for execution and performance.

### Strategic Partnerships

Build executive relationships and negotiate agreements that expand distribution, connect technology capabilities, and create commercial value.

### Commercial Execution

Align Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to bring offerings to market and remove barriers to growth.

## Commercial expertise

### Advertising sales and commercial leadership

I build and lead commercial teams, develop leaders and establish accountability for revenue growth. My experience connects sales strategy, business development and partnership execution.

### Advertising technology business development

My advertising technology business development experience includes X and Electronic Arts. I structure commercial partnerships and work across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance and Sales to connect partner capabilities with advertiser needs and market adoption.

### Global agency partnerships and advertiser investment

I develop holding-company partnerships and joint business plans that connect executive strategy with agency planning, buying and activation. The objective is sustained advertiser adoption, investment and expansion.

### Data, measurement and attribution

I bring data partnerships, advertising measurement and attribution into commercial planning so advertisers can evaluate business outcomes and make informed investment decisions. This work connects partner capabilities, advertiser needs and commercial execution.

### Gaming and interactive entertainment

At Electronic Arts, I lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships across gaming and interactive entertainment, connecting agency demand with advertising opportunities built around participation and engagement.

### Commercialization, monetization and go-to-market strategy

I help turn new advertising capabilities into commercial propositions, partner programs and repeatable go-to-market execution. My experience spans search, video, social advertising, augmented reality and gaming.

### Commercial leadership for AI and emerging platforms

My career has centered on businesses navigating changes in technology and consumer behavior.

I bring experience building the commercial strategy, teams, and partnerships needed to turn those changes into growth. That experience applies to AI and other technology companies developing new markets, expanding partner ecosystems, or scaling their commercial organizations.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#expertise
